threat_event: Business email compromise: a phishing page relays the owner's password and text code, the attacker reads the mailbox, sets a hidden forwarding rule, and steals attachments with client personal information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Email MFA by text code only; forwarding to outside addresses allowed; no rule alerts; sign-in history never reviewed; no phishing training; attachments with driver license and Social Security numbers kept in the mailbox
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 email and files; BP-01; BP-03
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); Fla. Stat. 501.171(3)-(5); Carrier DSA (72-hour notice)
existing_controls: Text-code MFA; vendor spam and phishing filter
treatment_plan: Authenticator app or security key for email; block outside forwarding and alert on new rules; monthly sign-in review; security training with a business email compromise module; P08 runbook

threat_event: Clients pay agency-billed premiums to a criminal's account after a fake invoice or a changed bank detail sent from the agency's mailbox or a lookalike domain
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Invoices carry trust account details by email; clients never told bank details will not change by email; no callback rule; near miss on 2026-07-08
affected_asset_or_process: BP-03 premium collection; premium trust account
existing_controls: Clients who know the owner sometimes call first
treatment_plan: Put the trust account details on the AMS invoice template and in a one-time letter that says they never change by email; ask clients to confirm by calling the number on file; owner never changes payment details on email request; report lookalike domains

threat_event: Client personal information is disclosed through misdirected email attachments, a lost phone holding texted ID photos, or a compromised client mailbox
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Applications, bank draft forms, and ID photos sent and received as plain attachments and texts; AMS upload portal unused; phone keeps photos
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); Carrier DSA (16 CFR 314.4(c)(3) benchmark)
treatment_plan: Turn on the AMS client upload portal and secure links; tell clients not to email or text ID documents; upload texted photos to the AMS and delete them; remote wipe on the phone

threat_event: Client information pasted into a consumer AI chatbot is kept or used to train the vendor's models, a disclosure the agency cannot control or undo
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consumer terms allow training (not opted out); no approved-tools list; about 40 client accounts pasted, 7 with driver license numbers
treatment_plan: Do not resume the consumer plan; delete chat history and opt out of training; counsel reviews whether notice is owed; any future AI use only in an approved tool with no-training terms and redacted inputs (P10)

threat_event: Fraudulent transfer from the premium trust account by someone using the owner's shared banking identity (impersonating the bookkeeper to get the texted code, or malware on the bookkeeper's computer)
threat_source: Cybercriminal (social engineering of the code relay)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bookkeeper signs in as the owner; owner texts one-time codes on request; bookkeeper's computer never seen; no security terms with the bookkeeper
existing_controls: Bank's own fraud monitoring; monthly reconciliation
treatment_plan: View-only bank sub-user for the bookkeeper; payment rights and codes for the owner only; bank alerts on every outgoing transfer; confidentiality and security terms with the bookkeeper

threat_event: Takeover of a password-only insurer portal or the comparative rater using reused or browser-stolen passwords, leading to fraudulent policy changes or access to client data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 insurer portals without MFA; rater MFA off; 23 passwords saved in the browser, 6 reused
treatment_plan: Password manager with unique passphrases; clear the browser store; turn on rater MFA; request MFA or AMS single sign-on from the 2 insurers

threat_event: Information-stealing malware or ransomware on the laptop takes saved passwords and synced files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Passwords saved in the browser; synced file folders; built-in antivirus only; shared home network
existing_controls: Automatic updates; built-in antivirus; full-disk encryption
treatment_plan: Password manager instead of the browser store; separate agency network; email and file backup with 1-year retention

threat_event: A compromised family or smart device, or the router's default admin password, lets an attacker reach agency traffic or devices on the home network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default router admin password; firmware never updated; one network for agency and family devices
existing_controls: SaaS traffic uses TLS; host firewall on
treatment_plan: New router admin password; firmware update; guest network for family and smart devices

threat_event: Owner is suddenly unavailable (injury, evacuation, or a lost phone after a hurricane), so nobody licensed can serve clients and nobody can reach the AMS, email, or bank
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single licensed person holds every role and credential; second factors on one phone; no emergency servicing arrangement
existing_controls: Insurer claims lines and service centers exist
treatment_plan: Written emergency servicing arrangement with another licensed agent; sealed recovery codes with the owner's attorney; client contact card with insurer claims lines; second authenticator in the fire safe (P05)

threat_event: Hurricane closes the home office for several days and soaks the garage paper files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Home office in a hurricane-exposed area; paper files 2014 to 2021 in garage boxes
existing_controls: Records of current policies are in the cloud AMS; phone hotspot
treatment_plan: Shred garage files past the 5-year period; move the rest into the AMS or a sealed container; evacuation kit (laptop, phone, chargers, printed contacts)

threat_event: A breach is not recognized in time and the Florida 30-day notice, the insurers' 72-hour notice, or the E&O notice is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or training; owner unaware of the clocks
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook with the notification matrix; printed contact list; walkthrough with the IT consultant

threat_event: Client information recovered from the unwiped retired laptop, the printer-scanner's storage, or garage paper after disposal or theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Retired laptop not encrypted or wiped; printer-scanner storage never cleared; no retention schedule
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 retired laptop and printer-scanner; garage paper
treatment_plan: IT consultant wipes the retired laptop and clears the printer-scanner storage; certified destruction for drives; disposal log; retention schedule

threat_event: The AMS becomes unavailable for days, or access is lost (vendor failure or contract dispute), and policy records cannot be produced
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS system of record; no export ever taken
existing_controls: Vendor backups and availability commitments (SOC 2, P09); insurer portals hold policy copies
treatment_plan: Quarterly full export of AMS records and documents to encrypted storage; confirm the contract's data return terms

threat_event: Email or files deleted by an attacker or by mistake and not noticed within the 30-day retention window
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No backup beyond 30 days of deleted items and versions
treatment_plan: Backup service for email and files with 1-year retention

threat_event: An insurer ends the agency's appointment or a regulator acts after a breach or a failed security questionnaire, because the agency cannot show a written program
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written program, risk assessment, or incident plan before 2026-09-14; questionnaire due 2026-09-30
existing_controls: This register, POL-01, and the P08 runbook (adopted 2026-09-14)
treatment_plan: Send the questionnaire with this program and the POA&M by 2026-09-30; keep the register current; review every August
